newsitem.title: USA: Paul-Son Gaming wins $1.2 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Paul-Son Gaming wins $1.2 mln in contracts.

text.p: Paul-Son Gaming Corp, a supplier of gambling equipment, on Monday said it has signed several one-year purchase contracts for playing cards valued at a total of $1.2 million.

The new playing card contracts call for the company to supply over 1.3 million decks to Showboat Inc 's Showboat Indiana, Players International Inc and the Isle of Capri casino in Biloxi, Mississippi.
"With our second playing card production line in San Luis, Mexico, we now have the capacity to produce over 15 million decks of playing cards yearly," President Eric Endy said in a statement.
"We plan to continue our aggressive efforts to expand our playing card sales and continue to increase our share of the casino and non-casino playing card markets," he said.
